harry_cs: FYI renewal flag on AuroraEdge. Daily inference calls dropped ~78% over the last 21 days. No reply from their platform lead since the last health review.
bench_bot: [ALERT] AuroraEdge - Usage -78% (21d), Active seats: 9/55, Health: 31/100. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/auroraedge/health
maria_csm: any reason in Sales notes? competitor outreach?
kyle_ae: Sales heard theyre running a shortside evaluation with DriftLabs. Asked for a side-by-side latency and cost comparison last week.
sre_nina: I audited their dedicated envoy logs — there are intermittent 503 spikes aligning with their tail latency issues on Feb 9. Opened ENG-11088 for an nginx worker tuning + epoll fix.
harry_cs: timeline looks like: infra instability -> champion goes quiet -> competitor pilot. This is classic at-risk.
maria_csm: proposed triage: 1) immediate 10-min health call with whoever is owning infra now 2) offer a zero-cost 7-day latency bench on their dataset 3) prepare a targeted reliability patch and run canary 4) offer a limited credit package to keep them engaged.
kyle_ae: i'll ask what specific DriftLabs feature they're testing. If it's purely latency, we can show config + p50/p95/p99 numbers. If it's cost, we'll need a per-embedding delta.
sre_nina: patch candidate ETA 36h for canary. I can produce before/after p99 graphs.
pricing_ops: approvals for credits up to $3k are fast-track if CS asks with a short rationale.
maria_csm: owners: @kyle_ae outreach + gather competitor asks; @sre_nina infra fix + bench; @harry_cs lead renewal play and credits ask.
harry_cs: outreach draft to customer: "Noticing a drop in usage and wanted to offer a short, no-cost benchmark to compare performance vs the DriftLabs pilot. We can also run a canary reliability patch on your instance to gather before/after p99s. 15 min this week?" Thoughts?
kyle_ae: good. add a line: "If helpful we can include a simple cost delta for typical query mixes so you can compare TCO."
sre_nina: i'll attach a short runbook of mitigations they can apply immediately if they want to self-test.
bench_bot: [REMINDER] Follow-up requested in 48h for customer reply.
maria_csm: thanks — i'll wait on the outreach result. If they ask for PO to unlock credits, escalate to me and i'll loop pricing_ops. :thumbsup:
